Question
========
Which of the following statements are correct?
(More than one statement may be correct.)

Answerlist
----------
* The concept of sustainable development is a biocentric concept, which is why it also takes animal rights into consideration.
* While the concept of sustainable development is an anthropocentric concept, the concept of ecosystem services is biocentric.
* Protecting a whole landscape because one views it as an end in itself is an exclusively biocentric perspective.
* Protecting plants because one views them as an end in themselves is a biocentric perspective.


Solution
========
Biocentric perspectives attribute intrinsic value to nature and non-human beings, meaning they are protected as ends in themselves. Protecting a landscape or plants for their own sake reflects such a biocentric view. In contrast, sustainable development is generally anthropocentric, and the ecosystem services concept is also anthropocentric because it values nature based on benefits to humans.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* True
